biggest_catch: The $100 credit only posts after the referred customer actually sets a new meter (by Jan 30 of the following year); a referral who signs up but never gets a meter set earns nothing.
catches: $100 credit applied to the referrer's existing natural gas account per referral — referrer side only; the referred friend gets service, not a stated credit.
Referred customer must sign up for service AND set a new meter; meter must be set by January 30 of the following year to receive credit.
Referrer must be a current member of a Utility Pipeline managed cooperative with account balance in good standing.
Referral is done via a printed application (online print-and-mail or by phone) naming the referrer — slower, paper-based process.
Utility Pipeline Ltd is an Ohio natural gas cooperative (nonprofit, member-owned); USD.
Framed as savings on planned energy spending, never income.

steps: Be a current member of a Utility Pipeline managed cooperative in good standing.
Get a Refer A Friend application (print from the PDF online or call 1-888-863-0032).
Have your friend fill out the application with your name and service address as the referrer.
Mail the application to P.O. Box 35519, Canton, Ohio 44735.
Friend signs up and sets a new meter (meter must be set by January 30 of the following year).
Customer Service applies a $100 credit to your existing natural gas account.
